question: Where should the practitioner understand the same ritual application to hold?
premises: The instruction directs the practitioner to know something.
The vicinity of jasmine and similar flowers is also included.
inference: The same application holds in the case of china-rose and likewise near jasmine and similar flowers.
uncertainties: The precise action to be understood is carried over from the preceding context.
plain_english: Know that the same applies in the case of china-rose and likewise near jasmine and similar flowers.
